messages.subject: shiny and javascript direct communication
parts:
Hi all,

I'm creating a rather complex user interface using a vector graphics library such as Raphael.js
Shiny works well with (and is reactive to) various html inputs like text, radio, checkboxes, listboxes etc.

I was wondering: is it possible to make a custom Javascript code "talk" with R via shiny?
A procedure like:
- something happens on the screen, due to a javascript code
- the user does something interpreted by the Javascript code
- the Javascript code asks something to R via shiny
- R responds back (via shiny) to the Javascript code, e.g. returning a JSON text object
- the Javascript code does something on the screen

Would that be possible?
I still very much like the way shiny can produce outputs and graphics, but I would still need a bit more flexibility to create custom communication protocols.

Thanks very much,
Adrian
